title: Glowing treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='38' ry='28' fill='#FFDD55' opacity='0.15'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#FFDD55' opacity='0.15'/>

  <!-- light rays from chest opening -->
  <polygon points='50,40 30,10 36,8' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 50,6 56,6' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 64,8 70,11' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 20,20 24,15' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.4'/>
  <polygon points='50,40 76,18 80,23' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- inner glow from open lid -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='22' ry='10' fill='#FFEE66' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='14' ry='6' fill='#FFFFCC' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- chest lid (open, tilted back) -->
  <path d='M22,42 Q22,28 50,26 Q78,28 78,42 L78,46 Q78,34 50,32 Q22,34 22,46 Z' fill='#A0642A'/>
  <path d='M22,42 Q22,28 50,26 Q78,28 78,42' fill='none' stroke='#C8884A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lid bands -->
  <rect x='34' y='30' width='3' height='16' fill='#FFCC33' rx='1'/>
  <rect x='63' y='30' width='3' height='16' fill='#FFCC33' rx='1'/>

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='32' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='46' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A87040'/>
  <!-- wood plank lines -->
  <line x1='22' y1='56' x2='78' y2='56' stroke='#7A4A20' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='66' x2='78' y2='66' stroke='#7A4A20' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- vertical gold bands -->
  <rect x='32' y='44' width='4' height='32' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <rect x='64' y='44' width='4' height='32' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <rect x='32' y='44' width='4' height='4' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <rect x='64' y='44' width='4' height='4' fill='#FFE680'/>

  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x='44' y='50' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='10' rx='1' fill='#FFAA00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='49' y='56' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>

  <!-- coins spilling out -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='2' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='2' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FFD700' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFF0A0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='3' fill='#FFD700' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFF0A0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFFFAA'>
    <polygon points='36,28 37,25 38,28 41,29 38,30 37,33 36,30 33,29'/>
    <polygon points='66,24 67,21 68,24 71,25 68,26 67,29 66,26 63,25'/>
    <polygon points='50,20 51,17 52,20 55,21 52,22 51,25 50,22 47,21'/>
    <polygon points='28,38 29,36 30,38 32,39 30,40 29,42 28,40 26,39'/>
    <polygon points='74,36 75,34 76,36 78,37 76,38 75,40 74,38 72,37'/>
  </g>
</svg>
